_classes.name: IDA 'each agency' (GML art 18-a industrial development agency) resolved to 'All agencies'/'State agencies' instead of a local IDA group
_classes.rule: agency in ('All agencies','State agencies') and re.search(r'General Municipal Law § ?8[5-8]\d', citation)

_classes.name: NYC chancellor / city school district actor left Unspecified (should be NYCPS, as 2011-S6732-61 and -84 are)
_classes.rule: agency=='Unspecified' and re.search(r'chancellor|^the district$', actor_raw.strip(), re.I)

_classes.name: List items under a mandatory 'the department shall determine whether' lead-in stored as powers (recurrence of the Oct 17 class said to be fixed tonight)
_classes.rule: file powers and kind_rule=='duty' and not kind_adjusted and re.search(r'\bshall\b|\bmust\b',quote) and not re.search(r'\bmay\b|authori[sz]|empower|\bpower|entitled|jurisdiction',quote,re.I) (broad: a sample shows some true powers such as 'shall be entitled'; judge before bulk fix)

_classes.name: Signage 'installation and maintenance' duty stored one-time (twin law 2015-S6064-01 is ongoing)
_classes.rule: re.search(r'installation and maintenance', quote, re.I) and recurrence=='one-time' (68 such records are 'ongoing')

_classes.name: Triggered deadline ('after the notice is received') stored on_effective_date
_classes.rule: deadline_kind=='on_effective_date' and re.search(r'after (the|such|each|any) [\w ]{0,30}(is|are|has been|have been) (received|filed|submitted|made)|upon (receipt|request)', quote, re.I)

_classes.name: Power quote opens with another record's duty sentence (truncated at a page marker)
designation_no_actor drops list items that sit under a mandatory lead-in ('the department shall determine whether: ... E-H')
_classes.rule: dropped rule=='designation_no_actor'; whether a lead-in exists needs the section text

_classes.name: New 'added criterion' items under an existing duty marked extends_existing false while sibling items are true
_classes.rule: no field separates a new list item under an existing lead-in

_classes.name: Permit term cap stored as a duty with passive actor_raw
_classes.rule: re.search(r'shall be valid for a (period|term) (of time )?not to exceed', quote, re.I)
